generator: Hc + thetaK Khat + thetaM Mhat on stride4
published_records: published_L5_L6.json sha256 computed at publication, before this training
tau_rule: max(1e-9, 10 times the largest absolute round-5 replay residual). Those residuals were about 1e-14.
fresh: 48 chains. L=1 is N(0,0.35). Each later depth resamples that same chain's energy-selected shells onto layer centers, copies gamma and theta, and reoptimizes every legal parameter.
descend: 24 starts at L3, L4 and L5 centered on the published L6 schedule resampled downward. L6 is a round trip of this arm's own L5 energy-selected schedule, then 12 starts at sigma 0.02 and 12 at sigma 0.1. Not a fresh discovery.
source_cost: Descending inclusive adds 53927 once, the round-5 arm-2 family inclusive that already contains the L6 cell (marginal 11244) and its upstream ladders. The fresh arm adds no stored-seed cost. 1556 is not added; it paid for the older control, not this vector.
order: publish records, then fresh L1 through L6, then descending L5, L4, L3, then the L6 round trip
